summary.headline: Horary Judgment of Illness
summary.text: Horary judgment of an illness: Mercury as lord of the ascendant and the Moon are void of course, signifying prolonged and severe infirmity, while the Moon’s application to Venus and Venus’s reception and conjunction with Jupiter promise eventual recovery, prosperity, and liberation as the illness diminishes.
